controles.affirmation: Les cinq premiers clients ont represente 40,3% du chiffre d'affaires en 2025 contre 32,4% en 2024 ; les deux premiers pesent 22,5% (11,7% et 10,8%)
controles.verbatim_source: In 2025, Lonza's largest customer accounted for 11.7% of total group sales (within the Advanced Synthesis and Integrated Biologics operating segments). The second-largest customer accounted for 10.8% of sales (within all three operating segments). The third to fifth largest customers accounted for 7.6%, 5.3%, and 4.9% of total group sales (continuing business), respectively. ... In 2024, Lonza's largest customer accounted for 9.7% and the second to fifth largest customers for 9.3%, 5.9%, 3.9%, and 3.6% (Annual Report 2025, note 2.5 Information About Major Customers)
controles.correction_proposee: Les totaux 40,3% et 32,4% sont des sommes derivees, exactes. Nuance : les deux premiers clients sont rapportes au 'total group sales', les 3e a 5e au 'total group sales (continuing business)'.

controles.affirmation: Specialized Modalities a recule de 5,9% en 2025
controles.verbatim_source: Specialized Modalities, For the twelve months ended 31 December : Sales 1,034 / 1,099 ; Change in % (5.9) ; Change in % at constant exchange rates (3.0) (Full-Year Report 2025)
controles.correction_proposee: Le -5,9% est la variation publiee (AER). Lonza commente le recul a change constant : -3,0%. Preciser la base retenue.

controles.affirmation: Specialized Modalities affiche une marge CORE EBITDA de 24,7% en 2025, la plus faible des trois plateformes
controles.verbatim_source: Specialized Modalities, Full-Year Report 2025 : Sales 1,034 / 1,099 ; CORE EBITDA 176 / 192 ; Margin in % 17.0 / 17.5. Le 24,7% appartient a une autre activite : "Capsules & Health Ingredients (CHI), now accounted for as Discontinued Operations, saw +4.4% CER growth in 2025 and CORE EBITDA margin improvement of +1.4ppts to 24.7%"
controles.correction_proposee: Erreur d'attribution grave : 24,7% est la marge CORE EBITDA de Capsules & Health Ingredients, activite abandonnee en cours de cession a Lone Star Funds, et non de Specialized Modalities. La vraie marge 2025 de Specialized Modalities est de 17,0% (17,5% en 2024). Le chiffre corrige est d'ailleurs coherent avec le +10,7 pts cite par l'ATT elle-meme pour arriver a 28,0% au S1 2026 ; a partir de 24,7% l'ecart serait de +3,3 pts, ce qui rend l'argument incoherent en l'etat.

controles.affirmation: Specialized Modalities est repartie a la hausse au S1 2026 : +22,6% a change constant, marge remontee a 28,0% (+10,7 pts)
controles.verbatim_source: Specialized Modalities returned to strong CER sales growth of +22.6% versus H1 2025. ... Driven by its return to growth, a favorable mix and cost discipline, the CORE EBITDA margin improved materially by +10.7ppts to 28.0%. (CP Half-Year 2026, 22 juillet 2026)

controles.affirmation: Marges de 36,0% pour Integrated Biologics et 48,1% pour Advanced Synthesis au S1 2026
controles.verbatim_source: The CORE EBITDA margin remained flat at 36.0% ... (Integrated Biologics) ; A strong operational execution, operating leverage and product mix led to an exceptional CORE EBITDA margin improvement of +6.8ppts to 48.1% versus H1 2025. (Advanced Synthesis) (CP Half-Year 2026)

controles.affirmation: Lonza indique elle-meme que la croissance du second semestre 2026 va se moderer par rapport au premier semestre, en raison d'une base de comparaison 2025 plus elevee
controles.verbatim_source: While H2 sales are expected to be higher than H1 in absolute terms, growth in H2 versus prior year will moderate due to a significantly higher prior-year base and a favorable H1 phasing. (CP Half-Year 2026) - cette phrase figure dans la section consacree a la plateforme ADVANCED SYNTHESIS, pas dans les perspectives groupe. Perspectives groupe : "For 2026, Lonza upgrades its CORE EBITDA margin outlook to 33-34% ... and confirms its expectation for CER sales growth of 11-12% ... with growth and profitability in H2 reflecting the planned phasing of business activities, particularly within Advanced Synthesis, and a higher prior-year base."
controles.correction_proposee: Deux corrections. 1) La phrase citee est propre a Advanced Synthesis : la presenter comme une guidance groupe la generalise abusivement. 2) Lonza ecrit 'growth in H2 versus PRIOR YEAR will moderate' et precise dans la meme phrase que 'H2 sales are expected to be higher than H1 in absolute terms'. L'ATT ecrit l'inverse ('va se moderer par rapport au premier semestre'). Reformuler : 'la croissance du second semestre en glissement annuel se moderera face a une base 2025 plus elevee, meme si les ventes du S2 sont attendues superieures a celles du S1 en valeur absolue'.

controles.affirmation: Le site de Vacaville (environ 0,6 Md CHF de ventes en 2025) est attendu stable sur 2026 par rapport a 2025
controles.verbatim_source: Vacaville showed an H1-weighted sales phasing, while Full-Year 2026 sales are expected to be flat versus Full-Year 2025. (CP Half-Year 2026) ; The Vacaville site contributed approximately CHF 0.6 billion in sales, slightly above expectations (Annual Report 2025)

controles.affirmation: Lonza anticipe un impact de change negatif de 2 a 3% sur ses ventes 2026, apres un vent contraire de 2,5 points en 2025 ; marges protegees par la couverture naturelle et le programme de couverture
controles.verbatim_source: Assuming the spot rates of mid-July 2026 prevail through H2, Lonza anticipates a FX growth headwind of approximately -2 to -3% on sales in 2026. This is largely driven by the full-year effect of the weakening of the US Dollar in 2025 ... With a robust natural hedge and Lonza's financial hedging program, margins will only be minimally impacted. (CP Half-Year 2026). Ecart 2025 : +21,7% CER contre +19,2% publie = 2,5 points

controles.affirmation: Lonza a indique que les grands laboratoires pourraient retarder leurs decisions d'externalisation en raison de la pression a investir aux Etats-Unis (WSJ, 8 mai 2026)
controles.verbatim_source: Titre : "Lonza Says Big Pharma Might Delay Outsourcing Decisions Amid U.S. Investments" ; chapeau : "The investments are more likely to represent a shift in spending toward the U.S. than a fundamental change in sourcing strategies, the contract drug manufacturer said." The Wall Street Journal, 2026-05-08 (src/data/v2-pipeline/lonn.sw.json, events)
controles.correction_proposee: Source de presse et non document reglementaire ; l'ATT le mentionne correctement. Le chapeau cite attenue le risque (pas de changement fondamental des strategies d'approvisionnement) et l'ATT le reproduit, ce qui est equilibre.
